verdict.rationale: A transcription API service could plausibly offer triggered or scheduled automations, such as auto-transcribing new files as they land in a bucket, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand modes: synchronous fast mode, live WebSocket streaming, and batch jobs the developer submits. Batch jobs over an S3 prefix are developer building blocks, not a documented capability to set up automations that run autonomously in the background, and no schedules, triggers or watchers are evidenced.
